provenance.basis: Fictional source-claim cases with the vocabulary of four roles outside software

sourceChunks.text: Registered Nurse (Adult), NMC PIN 12A3456E, revalidated in March 2025.

claims.text: Registered Nurse (Adult) with NMC registration, revalidated in March 2025.
claims.rationale: n01 names the registration, the NMC and the revalidation date.

claims.text: Registered Nurse (Adult) with NMC registration, revalidated in March 2023.
claims.rationale: n01 gives March 2025, not 2023.

sourceChunks.text: Hold current ALS and BLS certificates from the Resuscitation Council UK.

claims.rationale: n04 lists both certificates and the issuer.

claims.text: Current Advanced Life Support certificate from the Resuscitation Council UK.
claims.rationale: n04 says ALS, which is Advanced Life Support.

claims.text: Current PALS certificate from the Resuscitation Council UK.
claims.rationale: n04 names ALS and BLS, not PALS.

sourceChunks.text: Six months in the ICU at Larkfield General caring for ventilated patients.

claims.rationale: n06 says ICU, which is the intensive care unit.

claims.text: Two years in the ICU at Larkfield General caring for ventilated patients.
claims.rationale: n06 gives six months.

sourceChunks.text: Approved Electrician, JIB Gold Card holder, NVQ Level 3 in Electrotechnical Services.
Qualified to the 18th Edition of BS 7671 and to inspection and testing (City & Guilds 2391-52).

claims.text: JIB Gold Card holder, qualified to the 18th Edition of BS 7671.
